items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Johnson was in that band... So he played for Bud and all the other thing.

ctx.x: Which was a good band, because they had Booker Pittman, (inaudible) and Buddy Johnson was in that band, Herschel, and when ______ went out, I think Buster Smith came in. And you hear them, you get with that band a little while and then -- let's go to the Blue Devils. You get hungry and you go to the Blue Devils.
Do you know why they called it the Blue Devils?
